# chameleon_principal_role (Data Source)

Look up an existing Polaris principal role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "chameleon_principal_role" "data_reader" {
  name = "data_reader"
}

output "data_reader_properties" {
  value = data.chameleon_principal_role.data_reader.properties
}
```
